capabilities: : Create cards from selected text or images
extras: MIT licensed. Supports Chinese UI and full mobile support. No telemetry unless AI Host is configured.
intentEvidence: Create flashcards straight from your notes and review them with FSRS-5 spaced repetition.
problem: Users need an efficient way to convert existing notes into structured flashcards and manage spaced repetition review within Obsidian.

relations.evidence: Optional AI drafts. With the companion AI Host plugin, turn text, a selection or an image into an editable card draft.

summary: A flashcard system that generates cards from selected text in notes and uses FSRS-5 spaced repetition for review.
